ExecutionConfig.description: How portfolios are scheduled across the build and solve phases.

executor.description: `process` (spawned workers; required for `parallel` because cvxpy solves are not thread-safe) or `thread` (for I/O-bound builds).

max_workers.description: Worker count. Results are consumed in solve order, so this never changes the output.
max_workers.title: Max Workers

mode.description: `sequential`: build and solve one after another with a live chain context. `parallel_build_sequential_solve`: build in workers, solve in order (constraints may use `chain`, rules may not use `ctx`). `parallel`: everything in workers; no chain-aware steps allowed.

on_error.description: `fail_fast` stops after the first failed portfolio and records the rest as skipped; `continue` isolates failures. Chain-aware steps require `fail_fast`.

RateLimitConfig.description:
Bounds shared by every dataset that names this pool.

At least one of `requests_per_second` and `max_in_flight` is required. The loader receives the pool as
`request.rate_limiter` and wraps each call to the backend in it.

burst.description: Requests that may be made at once before the rate applies; defaults to `requests_per_second` rounded up. Requires `requests_per_second`.
burst.title: Burst

max_in_flight.description: Maximum simultaneous requests across every loader in the pool. Omit for no concurrency bound.
max_in_flight.title: Max In Flight

requests_per_second.description: Sustained request rate the pool allows, refilled continuously (a token bucket). Omit for no rate bound.

description:

Validated strictly: unknown keys are errors, money is written as strings, timestamps carry a zone.

portfolios.description: The portfolio list (`portfolio_id`, `solve_order`): a bare loader step, or `{"loader": step, "rate_limit": ...}` to bound its source. Portfolios are processed in ascending `solve_order`.

rate_limits.description: Named rate-limit pools for loaders, e.g. `{"vendor_api": {"requests_per_second": 20, "max_in_flight": 8}}`. A dataset opts in with `rate_limit`; datasets naming the same pool share its budget.
